items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 48:1
items.html: It means that there are many records there that could not be renewed in that coupling, and therefore they demand their correction and rise as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] for a new coupling. (p. 609, Item 18, and Inner Light there, Sub Header, “Multiplicity”)
